title: Anyone been here?
content: This is my first time seeing this community and am intrigued. Anyone had similar dream locations? All of these examples are very much reoccurring, I'm talking hundreds of times I've been to some of these places. A crazy amusement park of some kind. Lots of the time it exists over water. An extremely large, fancy and maximalist hotel/mansion that happens to be a bit dilapidated (kind of falling apart) (featuring lots of gold, marble and red velvety carpets) A sort of bathhouse location, lots of tile everywhere, staggered pools all over the place and stairs A series of restaurants and random roadside huts/shops. In the middle of nowhere right next to a narrow, empty desert highway. Each restaurant or shop is familiar even down to the people working A dark underground industrial space with chainmail fences, areas of water, lot of concrete, and machinery. A highway of sorts with very morphed perspectives and the ability to travel on it extremely quickly A beachside community with very steep hills and erratic ocean &#x200B; &#x200B; &#x200B;
